# Project Coding Standards

This repository keeps project guidance intentionally brief. The detailed business, technical, and feature-level requirements live in the spec set under `specs/` and should be treated as the source of truth for implementation work.

## Authoritative spec files

- `specs/README.md` — top-level index for the numbered feature and technical docs
- `specs/technical/` — generic technical and architecture guidance
- `specs/01-home-dashboard.md` — Home Dashboard spec and subtopics
- `specs/02-soap-api-test/` — SOAP API Test spec and subtopics
- `specs/03-rest-api-test/` — REST API Test spec and subtopics
- `specs/04-file-management/` — File Management spec and subtopics
- `specs/05-test-suite/` — Test Suite spec and subtopics
- `specs/06-monitoring-health/` — Monitoring & Health spec and subtopics
- `specs/07-ad-viewer/` — AD Viewer spec
- `specs/08-settings/` — Settings spec

## Working rules

- Read the relevant feature or technical spec before editing code.
- Keep changes narrow and aligned to the active feature being requested.
- Match the existing solution structure in `Features/`, `Components/`, and `WebApp/OrbitHub.Web/`.
- Avoid broad refactors or out-of-scope changes unless the user explicitly asks for them.
- This Project Website is deployed per Environment.
- The version for any entity in the database is managed and named as follows: YY.QQ.NN
  - **YY:** Last two digits of year
  - **QQ:** The quarter index of the year, considering the start of the year is January.
  - **NN:** The index or auto increment number
